observations.name: A SIGTERM to the process that the command `helics_broker` starts
observations.observed: `helics_broker` of the pip wheel is a Python script that runs the broker as a child. The script exited (code -15), and the broker went on: it still listens on 0.0.0.0:23404, 0.0.0.0:23405. A signal to the whole process group, as systemd sends to a unit, stops both.

observations.name: Where a broker listens
observations.observed: With no interface option: 127.0.0.1:23404, 127.0.0.1:23405. With `--ipv4`, as the `helics` app starts it: every address (see the next row). With the options of the `ot-sim` app (`--ipv4 --web --http_server_args=--http_port=8080 --external`): 0.0.0.0:23404, 0.0.0.0:23405, 0.0.0.0:8080. A server that then asks for 127.0.0.1:8080, as the event API of `sim-ctl` does, gets: no bind ([Errno 98] Address already in use).

observations.name: By default, a second broker on the same network and port
observations.observed: `--name ep-sim-ctl -f2 --ipv4` exited with code 252 after 4.6 s ( reply socket giving up tcp://*:23405 / [2026-11-24 08:50:04.759] [console] [error] commERROR||ep-sim-ctl (1)[connecting]::receiver connection failure / Broker is unable to connect). The first broker listens on 0.0.0.0:23404, 0.0.0.0:23405. The app starts the broker with `&`, so nothing reports the exit.

observations.name: By default, a field device of one site that reaches the waiting broker of another site
observations.observed: `rio-cellar` of ep, pointed at 172.18.10.1, joined the federation of `fr-sim-ctl`: True. It received 165 values over 5 steps. In 5 of those steps, every value equals the reference of fr. In 0 steps, every value equals the reference of its own site. The broker's federates: ['cellar', 'rio-cellar']. No message names the wrong site.

observations.name: A federate that a running broker refuses
observations.observed: `rio-cellar` of fr came late to its own broker and got: HelicsException: [-1] broker responded with error: already in initialization mode. After the refusal, the first federate of that federation (`cellar` of fr) exited with code 1 (helics.capi.HelicsException: [-10] publications not allowed outside of execution and initialization state). The broker's log: [info] fr-sim-ctl::got disconnect from cellar_core_W5IBEi(0) / [info] fr-sim-ctl::got disconnect from cellar_core_W5IBEi(1879048192). The broker dropped the first core that had registered, not the one that it refused.

observations.name: A broker key (`--brokerkey`, or HELICS_BROKER_KEY for a federate)
observations.observed: The broker of fr has the key `fr-key`. A stand-in of ep with the key `ep-key` got: HelicsException: [-1] broker responded with error: broker key does not match. It did not join (federates created: []). The same refusal after `cellar` of fr registered with the right key from its environment: that cellar exited with code 1 (helics.capi.HelicsException: [-6] HELICS system failure). A key stops the join. It does not protect the federation that the stranger reached.

observations.name: The real federate takes the broker key from its environment
observations.observed: With HELICS_BROKER_KEY in the federate's environment file and no change to `federate.py`, the federation ran: True (231 values, 0 not equal to the reference). The port check does the same with HELICS_BROKER_PORT.

observations.name: A broker name (`--name` at the broker, `--brokername` at the federate)
observations.observed: A stand-in that asked for the broker `ep-sim-ctl` at the address of `fr-sim-ctl` joined: True. The zmq core finds its broker by address and port. It does not compare the name.

observations.name: A restart of the federates alone, with the broker left up
observations.observed: The federation ran 62 steps. Then both federate units restarted (`Restart=always`, `RestartSec=5`), and the broker (`--autorestart`) stayed. In 261 s, `cellar` started 43 times and the stand-in 45 times. The broker's answer: HelicsException: [-1] broker responded with error: already in initialization mode. The federation did not run again.

observations.name: A restart of the broker alone, with the federates left up
observations.observed: The federation ran 62 steps. Then the broker stopped, and it started again 2 s later with the same command. In 261 s, the `cellar` unit started its process again 0 times. The federate logged 258 lines with `forced Granted Time`: with HELICS's real-time flag it steps on alone, and it does not register at the new broker. The stand-in started again 0 times (HelicsException: [-101] core lost connection with broker). The federation did not run again.
